assumptions: No finding is accepted or resolved automatically. APPRFL=N records are development outputs.

findings.title: Choose the analysis stage, cutoff, and amendment
findings.summary: The supplied KN564 input contains protocol 564-04 (13-Oct-2020) and a supplemental SAP (22-Dec-2020). No approved synthetic analysis cutoff or data-lock snapshot is supplied. All available source records are retained; this is not a cutoff-specific analysis.
findings.proposed_action: Specify the target analysis, governing amendment/SAP, cutoff date, and rules for records received after cutoff.

citations.quote: Three interim analyses are planned in addition to the final analysis for this trial. In this study, the futility bounds are non-binding. Results of the interim analyses (IA) will be reviewed by an eDMC. If both DFS and OS null hypotheses are rejected prior to the final analysis, the eDMC may recommend stopping the trial early for efficacy. At each IA, the eDMC may also recommend stopping the trial early for futility. Details on how the above planned analyses are incorporated into establishing statistical significance and the boundaries with regard to efficacy and futility are discussed further

choices: Use supplied amendment for synthetic descriptive work

findings.title: Approve the date-only baseline convention
findings.summary: The draft uses the latest nonmissing Screening/Cycle 1 assessment on or before first treatment, ordered by date, source visit order, then source sequence. Collection and dosing times are absent. A same-day record cannot establish that collection preceded dosing. Baseline values and changes are development candidates.
findings.proposed_action: Confirm pre-dose ordering or supply timestamps. Approve or replace the explicit date-only candidate rule before inferential use.

citations.quote: The All Participants as Treated (APaT) population will be used for the analysis of safety data in this study. The APaT population consists of all randomized participants who received at least 1 dose of study treatment. Participants will be analyzed in the treatment group corresponding to the study treatment they actually received for the analysis of safety data using the APaT population. For most participants this will be the treatment group to which they are randomized. Participants who take incorrect study treatment for the entire treatment period will be included in the treatment group corr

choices: Accept the date-only rule for this synthetic exercise

findings.title: Reconcile collected dates and supplied relative days
findings.summary: The draft derives SDTM and ADaM relative days from collected dates and the reference date. Some supplied source day fields may disagree. Source CSVs retain both the original dates and day values; dates have not been moved to force agreement.
findings.proposed_action: Correct the synthetic generator or document which temporal representation governs each endpoint and visit window.

findings.title: Laboratory grading and shift analyses lack required metadata
findings.summary: Normal ranges, ULN/LLN, clinical-significance flags, and complete units are not collected. The draft assigns units only where KN564 ItemDef descriptions explicitly state them. Other units remain missing. Numeric results and candidate baseline changes are retained without inventing reference ranges or CTCAE grades.
findings.proposed_action: Provide an approved parameter/unit/reference-range map and the applicable grading specification before laboratory shifts, Hy's law, or new toxicity grades are calculated.

findings.proposed_action: Supply and approve units and any conversion or abnormality criteria.

findings.title: Confirm reconstructed randomization strata
findings.summary: Treatment assignment and baseline characteristics are present, but an independent randomization/IVRS stratification file is not. KN189 platinum strata use the first recorded platinum treatment. KN564 M1 NED is a single stratum; M0 uses ECOG and US status. These reconstructions require confirmation.
findings.proposed_action: Reconcile against the randomization record or explicitly approve these source-based strata. Preserve ITT assignment for efficacy and actual treatment for safety.

choices: Approve reconstructed strata for synthetic work

findings.title: Death dates are not independently collected for every death
findings.summary: Many deaths appear in the precomputed OS summary without a dated DEATH disposition. ADSL.DTHDT is explicitly derived from the source OS duration and reference date, not independently observed. This limits independent OS/DFS/PFS reconstruction.
findings.proposed_action: Provide dated death and last-known-alive records, then reconcile source summaries and rederive endpoints.

citations.quote: The non-parametric Kaplan-Meier method will be used to estimate the survival curves. The hypotheses of treatment difference in survival will be tested by the stratified log -rank test. A stratified Cox proportional hazard model with Efron's method of tie handling will be used to estimate the magnitude of the treatment difference (ie, the HR). The HR and its \(95 \% CI\) from the stratified Cox model with a single treatment covariate will be reported. The stratification factors used for randomization will be applied to both the stratified log-rank test and the stratified Cox model.

findings.title: Reconcile source summaries and assessment-based endpoint candidates
findings.summary: ADTTE keeps source-summary endpoints separate from assessment-based candidates (PFSCAND/DFSCAND). Candidate censoring is intentionally incomplete: missing-scan and subsequent-therapy sensitivity rules are not implemented, and some death dates are source-implied. Differences are review evidence, not proof that either representation is correct. ANL01FL remains missing and APPRFL=N.
findings.proposed_action: Review the measured duration/status differences, decide the governing source, correct inconsistent inputs, and implement the approved cutoff and censoring rules.

findings.summary: The extract contains assessment dates and some subsequent therapies but no complete missed-assessment schedule, missed-scan reasons, or independently reconciled event/censor history. Assessment-based candidates must not be substituted for the SAP primary or sensitivity endpoints.
findings.proposed_action: Supply scheduled/actual scan status and missing-scan reasons, verify treatment changes, and author the complete primary/sensitivity censoring specifications.

findings.title: Dictionary versions and complete controlled terminology are missing
findings.summary: Source AE preferred terms/SOCs and medication names are retained. MedDRA and WHODrug versions and licensed dictionaries are not supplied. LIFE-THREATENING severity is mapped to SEVERE for SDTM while the original value is retained in SUPPAE. Source race/country text is retained in SUPPDM.
findings.proposed_action: Choose the controlled terminology release and dictionary versions; review coding and validate against the authorized terminology. Do not interpret retained terms as a verified dictionary recode.

findings.title: Confirm safety windows, dose interruptions, and actual treatment rules
findings.summary: The draft treats recorded placebo administrations as treatment despite zero placebo dose. Dose records marked interrupted/withdrawn are excluded from first/last administered-dose dates. TEAE windows use 30 days for nonserious events, up to 90 days for serious events, shortened to 30 when new anticancer therapy begins in follow-up. Pre-existing worsening, product-specific causality, and exact last administration times are not fully collected.
findings.proposed_action: Confirm the administration convention, initial/crossover treatment periods, safety follow-up rules, and treatment-specific attribution before final safety summaries.

findings.title: Item-level PRO scoring and compliance cannot be reproduced
findings.summary: Only selected summary scores are supplied. Item responses, missing-item scoring inputs, translation availability, and eligibility/noncompletion reasons are absent. Full instrument scoring and scheduled-eligible compliance denominators cannot be independently reconstructed.
findings.proposed_action: Provide item-level PRO forms, scoring manuals, assessment eligibility, and noncompletion reasons; limit current work to observed-score descriptive summaries.

citations.quote: Completion and compliance of EORTC QLQ-C30, FKSI-DRS and EQ-5D by visit and by treatment will be described. Numbers and percentages of complete and missing data at each visit will be summarized. An instrument is considered complete if at least one valid score is available according to the missing item rules outlined in the scoring manual for the instrument.

findings.title: Approve output standards and the submission package scope
findings.summary: Draft outputs use SDTMIG 3.4, ADaMIG 1.3, and Define-XML 2.1.0 in context Other. ZX (efficacy source summaries) and KN189 XP (subsequent therapy) are sponsor-defined domains. Formal CT/CORE validation, annotated CRF page links, full trial-design domains, and reviewer-guide sign-off remain outstanding. XSD validation is XML structure validation, not regulatory validation.
findings.proposed_action: Confirm standard versions and custom-domain placement; complete terminology, trial-design, aCRF, conformance and independent programming review before submission use.
choices: Adopt the proposed versions for development

findings.title: Confirm the retained MMD conversions and independent review
findings.summary: The uploaded protocol_mmd.zip and sap_mmd.zip are byte-identical within this study. They supply a combined protocol/SAP conversion, not two independent sources. The draft preserves both original ZIPs and the extracted MMD. PDF layout, table transcription, and figure fidelity have not been independently checked against publisher PDFs.
findings.proposed_action: Confirm the retained versions and original PDF transcription, and perform independent statistical-programming review. Do not count duplicate archives or shared-engine reruns as independent validation.

findings.title: ODM integer declarations contain fractional laboratory values
findings.summary: Some KN564 ItemDefs declare integer but clinical ItemData contains fractional values. The adapter preserves the original text; yamaa explicitly parses numeric results as float without rounding. The metadata discrepancy remains open.
findings.proposed_action: Correct the ODM metadata types or confirm the intended numeric precision; retain the original values.

findings.title: BICR EFS and baseline-disease sensitivity strata are missing
findings.summary: Recurrence forms lack a separate BICR endpoint and baseline BICR disease-status variable. Investigator and BICR results cannot be separated. The supplemental SAP six-stratum BICR sensitivity model and censoring at randomization for baseline BICR disease cannot be reproduced.
findings.proposed_action: Provide baseline and longitudinal BICR adjudication, or exclude these analyses explicitly.

findings.title: Disease-recurrence-specific survival lacks cause of death
findings.summary: OS/DFS status is present, but death attributable to RCC is not collected for all deaths. Overall mortality cannot be treated as RCC-specific mortality.
findings.proposed_action: Provide adjudicated cause-of-death records or omit disease-recurrence-specific survival.

citations.quote: The nonparametric cumulative incidence estimator will be used to estimate the DRSS1 and DRSS2 curves in each treatment group. For DRSS1, only local recurrence is counted as an event. Death, or occurrence of distant kidney cancer metastasis(es) will be censored at documented date of disease metastasis or death, whichever occurs first. For DRSS2, only disease recurrence with visceral lesion is counted as an event. Death, local recurrence without visceral lesion, distant metastasis without visceral lesion will be censored at documented date of disease recurrence or death, whichever occurs first.

findings.title: The prespecified week-52 PRO analysis needs a coverage check
findings.summary: The supplemental SAP selects week 52 and defines its day window as 352-546. Source nominal visit labels cannot be substituted for that window. Physical functioning, nausea/vomiting, and diarrhea scales are absent. Counts in the specified day window are measured separately; eligible-participant denominators remain unknown.
findings.proposed_action: Supply week-52 observations and missing scales, or agree a different exploratory timepoint. Do not relabel the last-dose or later follow-up scores as week 52.

citations.quote: The time point for the mean change from baseline is defined as the latest time point at which CR-T \(\geq 60 \%\) and CR-E \(\geq 80 \%\) and week 52 was selected based on blinded data review prior to the database lock for any PRO analysis.

findings.title: COVID-19 sensitivity analyses lack missing-scan reasons
findings.summary: COVID-related missed imaging/censoring indicators are not collected. The SAP trigger and tipping-point sensitivity cannot be evaluated from dates alone.
findings.proposed_action: Provide scan-level COVID missingness and censoring reasons, or document this sensitivity analysis as unsupported.
